response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive experience in full-stack development, team leadership, and open-source contributions, aligning well with the Head of Development role. His track record includes architectural design, tech stack versatility, and mentorship. However, his German language proficiency (Basic) is a concern for client-facing leadership in a German-speaking context, and his UML expertise is not explicitly mentioned in the resume.
strengths: Strong background in full-stack development with leadership experience in multiple roles
Proven track record in open-source projects and technical mentorship
Diverse technical stack (Python, D, JavaScript, TypeScript) and cloud/AI infrastructure experience
concerns: German language proficiency is listed as 'Basic', which may hinder client communication
No explicit mention of UML or architecture modeling expertise in the resume
Limited direct experience with requirements management and complex IT system design in leadership contexts
